seo.title: RAVU — Cheaper insurance, parts and repairs for Tanzania's riders and drivers
seo.description: RAVU is a membership for boda boda riders, Bajaj operators and vehicle owners in Tanzania: discounted insurance, spare parts and garage servicing, and rides in the same app. Piloting in Dar es Salaam.

hero.title: Pay less to keep
hero.text: RAVU members get discounted insurance, spare parts and garage servicing from partner businesses, and book rides in the same app.
hero.socialProof: Riders, drivers and vehicle owners can register for the pilot.

features.title: Rides
features.text: Book and track trips in the RAVU app.

features.title: Preferred member pricing
features.text: Negotiated rates of 20–30% on insurance premiums and 10–25% on spare parts.

features.title: Verified members
features.text: Every member is checked before they get a RAVU ID.

slideshow.title: Insurance, parts and garages
slideshow.description: Insurers, parts shops and garages give RAVU members lower prices. Here's what's covered.

slides.caption: Dar es Salaam & Nationwide
slides.title: From boda boda & Bajaj to private cars, trucks, buses and fleets.
slides.description: Membership is open to motorcycle and Bajaj operators, private car owners, commercial drivers, and truck and bus fleets.
bullets: Motorcycles (boda boda & delivery) and Bajaj three-wheelers
Private family sedans, SUVs, pickups & household vehicles
Commercial taxis, ride-hailing, trucks, buses & corporate fleets
slides.imageAlt: RAVU multi-vehicle ecosystem in Dar es Salaam showing motorcycles, Bajaj, SUV, delivery truck and bus

slides.caption: 8 Protection Product Lines
slides.title: Cheaper cover for your vehicle, family and business.
slides.description: We're agreeing group rates with insurers. The target for verified members is 20–30% off premiums across 8 types of cover.
bullets: Motorcycle, Bajaj, Private Motor Vehicle & Commercial Fleet cover
Personal Accident, Health & Medical, Family Life & SME protection
Reduced deductibles, priority claims & 24/7 roadside assistance
slides.imageAlt: Tanzanian insurance advisor reviewing RAVU digital insurance policy with motorcycle rider and car owner

slides.caption: Official Service Network
slides.title: Spend less on parts and repairs.
slides.description: Partner shops and garages give members discounts on genuine parts, tyres, batteries, lubricants and repairs.
bullets: 10%–25% OFF motorcycle, car, truck & bus spare parts, tires & batteries
5%–20% OFF routine maintenance, engine, brake & suspension repairs
Commercial Fleet Discount Program with bulk pricing & priority bays
slides.imageAlt: RAVU partner mechanical garage and spare parts shop in Dar es Salaam

slides.caption: Digital & Physical ID
slides.title: Show your Member ID, pay the member price.
slides.description: Every verified member gets a RAVU Member ID. Partner staff check it in the Partner Portal and apply the discount.
bullets: Instant verification through the RAVU Partner Portal
Transparent member pricing across all participating branches
Loyalty rewards for safe, claim-free and active members
slides.imageAlt: Verified RAVU Rider Member ID card

slides.caption: Dar es Salaam Launch
slides.title: Launching in Dar es Salaam and scaling across Tanzania.
slides.description: Our 4–6 month Dar es Salaam pilot program connects 200–500 initial riders, drivers and vehicle owners directly with foundational insurance, spare parts and workshop partners.
bullets: Priority onboarding for Dar es Salaam riders, drivers & fleets
Direct referrals and marketing activations for foundational partners
Nationwide rollout once the pilot proves the discounts work
slides.imageAlt: RAVU Mobility Hub in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
